services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of your plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaking taps, blocked drains — we respond fast and carry full parts stock on the van. Most faults fixed same day, 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with full warranty and certification. We help you choose the right model for your home and budget, then handle the whole job.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your system running efficiently and catches small problems before they become expensive. We'll flush, balance, and test everything.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Cold spots, leaks, or noisy radiators? We repair what you have or fit new ones throughout your home. Honest diagnosis, no upsell.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New taps, shower installations, toilet repairs, and full bathroom replumbing. We work neatly and tidy up after ourselves.

services.title: Unvented Cylinder Installation
services.desc: Modern, efficient hot water without the tank. We survey your home, advise on the best option, and install with all necessary safety certification.

about_pullquote: We started because we saw too many cowboys charging too much. That's not us.
about_para_1: Star Plumbing & Heating has been serving Derby households for 18 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown into a team of four experienced engineers, each trained to Gas Safe standard. Over that time we've completed more than 2,500 jobs — from midnight emergency call-outs to planned boiler replacements — and we've built a reputation for turning up when we say we will, and delivering honest work at fair prices.
about_para_2: Most of our new work comes from referrals and repeat customers. We don't use pressure sales tactics or quote inflated prices. You'll get a straightforward diagnosis, a realistic quote, and a tradesperson who respects your home. If something's not urgent, we'll tell you. If it is, we'll be there fast.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Star Plumbing

reviews.text: Called at half-nine on a Sunday night with a leaking pipe under the kitchen. Mark was here by 10:15, diagnosed it straight away, and had it sorted by 11. Didn't try to sell us anything we didn't need. Fair price and left the place spotless. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our boiler serviced and they also spotted a problem with the flue that could have been dangerous. Fixed it same day and explained everything clearly. No hard sell, just honest advice. Brilliant lads.
reviews.author: Patricia W.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out for a burst radiator. Arrived within 50 minutes, fixed it properly, and the charge was exactly what they quoted. Much better than the last plumber we used. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David K.
